title: Planning a weekend trip
es: Proponer, opinar y decidir planes con un amigo
goal: Hacer sugerencias, comparar opciones, estar de acuerdo o no y llegar a un acuerdo.
phrases: How about we go to the coast?
¿Qué tal si vamos a la costa?
Preferiría quedarme en un sitio barato.

turns.t: Hey! So, about this weekend. I was thinking we could get out of the city for a couple of days. Any ideas?
turns.es: ¡Oye! Sobre este fin de semana. Pensaba que podríamos salir de la ciudad un par de días. ¿Alguna idea?

y.say: How about we go to the coast? It's only two hours by train and we could relax on the beach.
y.es: ¿Qué tal si vamos a la costa? Son solo dos horas en tren y podríamos relajarnos en la playa.
alts: Why don't we go to the beach? It takes two hours by train and we can relax.

turns.t: Hmm, that sounds nice, but I checked the forecast and it might rain on Saturday. The mountains could be a better option, and there's a lovely village with hiking trails. The only problem is that it's a bit more expensive to get there.
turns.es: Suena bien, pero vi el pronóstico y quizás llueva el sábado. La montaña podría ser mejor, con un pueblo con senderos. El problema es que llegar cuesta un poco más.

c.q: Why does the friend prefer the mountains?
o: The weather might be bad at the coast

y.say: I'd rather stay somewhere cheap, but I like hiking. Is there a bus instead of the train?
y.es: Preferiría un sitio barato, pero me gusta el senderismo. ¿Hay un autobús en lugar del tren?
alts: I prefer something cheap but I enjoy hiking. Can we take a bus instead?

turns.t: Good thinking. There's a bus at eight in the morning that costs half the price, although it takes three hours. We could also share a car with my cousin, who's going that way anyway.
turns.es: Buena idea. Hay un autobús a las ocho que cuesta la mitad, aunque tarda tres horas. También podríamos compartir coche con mi primo, que va para allá.

y.say: Sharing a car sounds better because it's faster. Let's split the cost of the petrol with him.
y.es: Compartir el coche suena mejor porque es más rápido. Dividamos la gasolina con él.
alts: Going by car with your cousin is better, it is faster. We can share the petrol cost.

turns.t: Deal. Now, where should we stay? There's a hostel in the village, or a small guesthouse that includes breakfast. The guesthouse is twenty euros more per night.
turns.es: Trato hecho. ¿Dónde nos quedamos? Hay un hostal o una casa de huéspedes con desayuno incluido, veinte euros más por noche.

c.q: What is the difference between the two places?
o: The guesthouse includes breakfast and costs more

y.say: If breakfast is included, I think the guesthouse is worth it. It depends on our budget, though.
y.es: Si el desayuno está incluido, creo que la casa de huéspedes vale la pena. Aunque depende de nuestro presupuesto.
alts: The guesthouse is worth the money with breakfast. But it depends on the budget.

turns.t: Fair enough. Let's book the guesthouse for one night and see how we feel. Are you free to leave on Friday after work?
turns.es: Justo. Reservemos la casa de huéspedes una noche y veamos. ¿Puedes salir el viernes después del trabajo?

y.say: Friday after six works for me. I'll pack tonight and bring some snacks for the trip.
y.es: El viernes después de las seis me viene bien. Prepararé la maleta esta noche y llevaré snacks.
alts: Friday at six is fine for me. I will pack tonight and bring snacks.
